response.rationale: Tier B cell with a moderate 12 orders in 28 days gives reasonable, though not ironclad, support for the mechanical read. Shrunk realised dROAS of 1.7155 clears the 1.45 goal with ~18% headroom, and the proposed +10% step (INR 350 -> 385) is a modest, well-sized raise rather than an aggressive jump. With shrinkage already applied and the margin comfortably above goal, there is no signal justifying dampening or amplifying the step; taking the full proposed raise is the closest-to-neutral action.
